programs.title: Sign-on
programs.blurb: Station identification, tonight's lineup and a word from our sponsors.

programs.title: The Blob
programs.blurb: A hungry, corrosive ooze from a fallen satellite creeps through a small California ski town, dissolving everyone in its path.

programs.title: Grabbers
programs.blurb: Blood-sucking tentacled monsters invade a remote Irish island, and the only defense is to get very, very drunk.

programs.title: Arachnophobia
programs.blurb: A deadly Venezuelan spider stows away to a sleepy California town and starts a family. A spider-phobic doctor has to deal with it.

programs.title: Jaws
programs.blurb: A great white shark stalks the beaches of Amity Island, and a police chief who hates the water has to go out on it.

programs.title: Cloverfield
programs.blurb: A Manhattan going-away party is interrupted by something enormous, all of it caught on one friend's handheld camcorder.

programs.title: The Thing
programs.blurb: At a remote Antarctic research station, a shape-shifting organism could be hiding inside any one of the crew.

programs.title: The Descent
programs.blurb: Six friends on a caving trip get trapped deep underground and discover they are not alone in the dark.

programs.title: Sign-off
programs.blurb: Closing announcements, the test pattern, and lights out. Thanks for watching.
